summary: APPROVED for these revision2 bytes only. Fresh complete Arabic-to-English and Arabic-to-Indonesian semantic review, with the entire style file read, yields 52 passing coverage checks and no actionable translation findings. All 33 logical source lines, eight divider positions, quantities, ordered Names, testimonies, formulas, three peace-only honorifics, negation/exception chains, actor/pronoun relations and the unfinished ending are covered. Thirteen accepted uncertainties belong to the frozen Arabic witness, not unresolved target errors. The revision2 L28 note removes the rejected preceding-command diagnosis while preserving actual linkage/addressee/instrumental uncertainty. All five raw SHA-256 pins matched before and after the complete review; page109 reader ar/en/id equals the reviewed blocks. Only Legacy604V2 was reviewed; paused616V3 excluded. No corpus, tracker or prior rejection was edited; this new artifact does not relabel revision1.
